item.description:
# Ghostex 11.3.0
## 11.3.0 - 2026-11-10
**Ghostex 11.3.0 is out.** Ghostex asks for approval only when someone new wants in, pairing a phone takes one window, connections between your computers and phones stay up, coordinators keep work items with what needs you right above the chat box, each project gets a main coordinator, terminals draw pictures, Windows builds are signed, and a new iPhone app is on its way.
### 🔐 Approvals only at the door
- **Ghostex asks only at the door, with one click:** a plain Approve card shows when a new phone or computer asks to pair (compare the three words), when a Collab guest sends a message in Ask me mode, and when an agent turns on Easy Connect, lets a device into it or shares a chat. Approve no longer asks for Touch ID, Windows Hello or a password unless you turn that on. - **Everything else just works, for you and your agents:** connecting your computers, every setting (including the ones agents were refused), GBots, Autopilot, Cloud Boxes, teams, extensions, secret providers and starting an agent with full access no longer ask or say "only you can do this". Agents still can't approve a card, answer a secret request or read your secrets. - **New switch: require Touch ID or your password to approve** (Settings > Security; Windows Hello on Windows), off by default; on the phone it's "Require Face ID to approve" on the computer's page under Machines. It applies to every device that approves for that computer. - **Settings > Security shows what still asks, and holds the security log's switch:** a short list says exactly what asks for an Approve, the Touch ID switch explains itself in its card, and "Show the security log" (moved here from Settings > Extensions > Experimental, same setting) sits beside Open log. - **Approve any connected computer's cards from the one you're at:** a card from a computer you added under Settings > Remote can be approved right there; the "act as the owner" step on the other computer is gone, agents reach your connected computers as soon as you connect them, and a Mac restored from another Mac's backup no longer hides that Mac's cards. - **An approval card survives a restart and never dead-ends:** a request still waiting when Ghostex or a computer's gxserver restarts comes back with the same words and time left, so Approve still works. The same phone or agent asking again gets that request back, a different request replaces the waiting one, and a request that ran out of time says so ("This request expired. Ask again from the phone."). - **The security log says how each approval request ended:** approved (in the Ghostex app, on a paired phone or with the CLI), expired, replaced by a newer request, or withdrawn because the session that asked was closed. gxserver's own log follows each request by its id, and neither log holds a secret or a key. - **Older apps keep working:** phones and computers on older Ghostex versions keep connecting, and their Face ID or Touch ID approvals count as a plain Approve.
### 🤝 Pairing a phone or a computer
- **Connect a phone in one window:** the sidebar menu's Connect a phone (was Mobile & Remote) opens a window that turns Easy Connect on by itself and shows the code at once, with two plain steps, a line that shows it's waiting for your phone, and Copy the code. It replaces the Remote Setup dialog and the separate Show QR popup, and says you can also use Tailscale or connect another computer from the same window. - **One question for a phone that asks to pair:** the Connect a phone window, the notice that shows when that window is closed and the row in Settings > Remote all ask "Is this your phone?" (or computer) with its name, the three words side by side in large letters and Not my phone beside Approve; after Approve the window says "<phone> is connected" with Done. The window's "Need the app?" iPhone link opens the App Store. - **Settings > Remote fits on one screen:** no more tabs. "Phones and computers that can reach this machine" holds Easy Connect's switch, Connect a phone, Connect a computer and every paired or waiting device (a waiting one first, with its three words and Approve, whether Easy Connect is on or off); then "Computers this machine connects to" with Add a computer; then This computer, Tailscale and Advanced (now holding the Relay choice), each opening in place. - **The phone's first screen says what to do on each device:** three steps with icons (get Ghostex on the computer, click Connect a phone there, scan the code here) and one Scan the code button; Paste a code and Use Tailscale moved into "Other ways to connect", and Try a demo computer is a small link under the button. With the new phone app. - **The phone's scan screen says where the code is:** two steps with the camera inside the second, Paste a code instead as a full button and "It won't scan" for tips. Android keeps its live camera there and gains a light button; an iPhone opens Apple's scanner from that step. With the new phone app. - **Pairing a phone says what is happening, and why it failed:** after the scan the phone shows "Check your computer" with the three words and how long it still waits; a failed pairing stays on screen with the real reason ("Nobody approved this phone in time" is no longer "This code has expired") and Scan again, and a pairing that works opens your sessions with "Connected to <computer>" on top. With the new phone app. - **Phones on Tailscale, your network or SSH need no pairing:** with the new phone app they work, and can approve, from the first sign-in, with no "Approve this phone?" on the computer. An older phone app still asks once, and a phone waiting to pair now shows in Settings > Remote whether Easy Connect is on or off. - **Showing a pairing code no longer disconnects your connected devices:** the Connect a phone window and the code in Settings > Remote used to restart Easy Connect twice for every code shown, whether anybody paired or not, which cut every connected phone and computer for up to a minute each time. A new phone now reaches the computer through an address of its own, so the others stay connected while the code is on screen and when the window closes. They reconnect once when a new device actually joins: when you approve a phone, or when another computer connects with the text code. Phones on 11.2.1 and later pair as before.
### 🌐 Connections and remote computers
- **A computer you control over Easy Connect comes back in seconds, and working connections are left alone:** when the other computer's Easy Connect starts again (Ghostex updated or restarted there, a device added), this computer now notices in about 12 seconds and reconnects by itself instead of hanging for about a minute, and a network that is gone only for a moment still resumes without a reconnect. Terminals keep running when the sidebar reconnects, a second window no longer cuts the first one's connection, a connection is no longer dropped the fourth time its live updates hiccup, and a crashed Ghostex no longer leaves an Easy Connect helper behind that drops the next connection every few seconds (macOS and Linux). - **Every drop and return of a computer is written down with its reason:** `ghostex logs --file gpui-remote-gxserver-install-debug.log --grep link` shows them, and `ghostex logs --grep easyConnect.relay` shows an Easy Connect relay that keeps dropping its connections. - **Computers you control over Easy Connect stay connected to each other:** a computer you already paired gets connection keys of its own for each computer it reaches, by itself, with nothing to approve and no need to pair again, so the app's connection, Ghostex's own connection and a connection to a second computer no longer get in each other's way. - **A computer you first set up over SSH runs its newest Ghostex** (#533): when that computer also has Ghostex installed (a package, the AppImage or the Mac app), connecting starts whichever Ghostex there is newest instead of always the copy Ghostex installed over SSH, and an older one still running is replaced without closing its sessions. - **The Machine picker lists only connected computers:** on Settings > Agents, Integrations, Dictation and Updates it shows this computer and the ones connected right now ("Only connected machines shown"), and goes back to this computer when the one you picked disconnects.
### 🧭 Coordinators and work items
- **Coordinators keep work items:** one item per line of work, with where it stands, who has the ball (you, the coordinator or a thread) and one of six statuses: Needs you, Blocked, In progress, Waiting, Later and Finished. Threads, steps, questions for you and what it waits on belong to the item, and a wait on another item or question clears itself once that's done. Coordinators update them with `ghostex coordinator item` (add, now, step, ask, wait, done, drop, list); your board's open items move over once, keeping their numbers, and the older `ghostex coordinator board` commands keep working. - **Coordinators write news, not status sections:** a coordinator's reply is a couple of sentences of news, and one quiet line under it says what that turn changed ("Release notes started · 1 ask"), which opens the Work panel at that item; for the latest turn it is part of the "Worked for" line. Running coordinators re-read their playbook at their next message, and Marked handovers keeps working for every other session and for a coordinator's threads. - **What needs you waits right above the chat box, as one compact list:** each question or task is one row with its answer buttons (the recommended one starred) or Done and how long ago, with blocked work and what the latest turn finished below them; at most four rows (three on the phone), then "N more need you". Click a row to open it in place: its full text, its links, Reply (your own words, in the same reply bubble as a message's Reply), Open for a form or page, Mention, Show in chat, Dismiss and Snooze. Its × hides the whole list until something new needs you or you click the Work pill. On the computer, the web and the phone. - **Snooze or dismiss anything that asks you:** Snooze (1 hour, 6 hours or 24 hours) takes it out of the list and the Needs you count until its time is up, also across a restart; Dismiss withdraws it for good and tells the agent that asked. - **The Board pill is now Work, and it is the one place for the counts:** it reads "Work · 4 need you · 7 in progress" while the row has room and shows its coloured counts when the row is tight. The panel lists every line of work by who has the ball (Needs you first, then Blocked, In progress, Waiting, Later and Finished today), and a card that needs you opens to the same Reply, Show in chat, Dismiss and Snooze as a row above the chat box. In Columns, a click on a column's header folds it to a strip, Finished today is a column like the others, and the row scrolls sideways when the open columns don't fit. - **"In progress" instead of "Moving":** wherever you read a work item's status (the Work panel, its Columns, the phone, `ghostex coordinator item list`) it says In progress. - **GitHub links show their real state:** a PR or issue on a work item shows GitHub's mark and its state in that state's colour (open, merged, closed), whether the coordinator linked it or a thread added it. - **A question is asked once:** when a coordinator's reply asks a question that a work item also asks, only the ask shows, and answering either settles both. A question or task still open when its work is finished stays under Needs you until you answer it or the coordinator withdraws it. `ghostex coordinator item ask` answers can hold a comma (`--answer` repeated, or `\,` in `--answers`). - **Each project has a main coordinator on each computer:** the first coordinator you create in a project gets a quiet "Main" tag, and right-click (or long-press on the phone) > Make main coordinator gives it to another one. It is the one agents and Chief of Staff contact about that project: `ghostex agents send --main-coordinator --project-id <id> "…"` (add `--computer <name>` for another computer, and `--if-none create` or `--if-none session` for a project that has none). Closing the main one passes the tag to the oldest coordinator left. - **Coordinators wear a captain's hat:** a coordinator's row, its chat pills, its message cards, the `+` picker and the phone show a captain's hat instead of the crown. Chief of Staff keeps its crown. - **A coordinator's threads sit under its card in the Unified sidebar:** folded by default, with the crew count on the card to open and close them; an open card lists the busy and recent threads first and the rest behind one "N older threads" row, and a search or Reveal opens the way to a matching thread. On the computer, the web and the phone, thanks to @sebastianarena. - **New Coordinator picks where it runs:** for a project that is on more than one computer (or cloned twice), the New Coordinator dialog has a Computer field listing each copy, with that computer's own agents, models and playbook; a computer that is not connected shows greyed. On the phone, a Folder row picks between the clones of one computer, thanks to @sebastianarena. - **Coordinator in the New thread picker works in the Unified sidebar:** picking it opens the New Coordinator dialog, also for a project merged into another entry, thanks to @sebastianarena. - **Coordinators can save a rule for every coordinator:** give a lasting rule and the coordinator proposes the wording, then saves it as a playbook override once you confirm. `ghostex coordinator playbook --list-overrides` numbers them, and `--add-override`, `--replace-override <n>` and `--remove-override <n>` change one without touching the others. - **Make Coordinator sends its first message right away:** turning a session into a coordinator (right-click or `ghostex coordinator promote`) types the message that gives it the role at once instead of queueing it until the agent is idle; a sleeping or closed session is woken and gets it first. - **A message to a finished thread brings its report back:** a coordinator's follow-up to a thread it marked done reopens it under the coordinator and says "reopened", and a reply the thread finished while it was done is shown instead of being lost (#541), thanks to @sebastianarena. - **A message to a sleeping, closed or finished agent always says what happened** (#531): `ghostex agents send` and `ghostex coordinator reopen` answer within seconds (sent, or waiting for the agent to start) instead of timing out, a reopened thread's reply always reaches its coordinator, and sending the same message again while the first copy waits no longer delivers it twice. - **OpenCode threads open on their conversation, also on another computer** (#538): a thread's terminal shows the conversation instead of OpenCode's empty start page, a thread on another computer is no longer listed as Finished while it still works, and its coordinator hears "finished its turn" within seconds instead of 8 minutes later. The terminal part needs Ghostex updated on the computer running OpenCode.
### 💬 Chat
- **Unanswered forms and pages wait above the chat box in every chat:** a form or question page from a reply that still has open questions shows there as a small card (its title, how many questions are open, and Open) until every question is answered, skipped or withdrawn. It is the same list the ? pill counts, so nothing counts twice, and For later questions stay out. On the computer, the web and the phone. - **Nothing you click scrolls the chat to a question any more:** the ? pill, a Q12 tag in a message, a row of the Resources list and Open on a waiting form open the form in the popup over the chat, a question page opens as the page, and a coordinator's question opens in the Work panel. Show in chat is the one exception, and only when you press it. - **Quieter Autopilot and Resources pills:** the Autopilot pill's tooltip says just "Autopilot is on" or "Autopilot is off"; the Resources pill says just "Resources", with a number only while a question is unanswered (it used to count every form, page and visual ever made), and its list shows the newest 30 per group with one "Show all N" row for the rest. On the computer, the web and the phone. - **Chat look follow-ups (Settings > Chat > Advanced):** the `!` command card, picture-only messages and the loading placeholder follow Left aligned, Band and Compact, and Compact also tightens the gaps inside a reply. Agent work Reduced and Quiet fold a subagent's report into the agent's work line, keep questions and pictures in view, and the status line names the running call. A custom Transcript width is now the widest the transcript gets, so a side panel you open takes the empty space beside it first. On the computer, the web and the phone, thanks to @sebastianarena. - **Chat, phone and web follow-ups:** the chat's status bar names the running call while its sentence is folded, an answered question shows once, a Quiet chat shows its held words when the agent dies without a notice, and the web version follows this computer's Settings as they change, thanks to @sebastianarena. - **The chat box opens the moment you scroll back to the end:** after scrolling up folds it to one line, reaching the last message (with the wheel or the scrollbar), a click or a keystroke opens it at once, with no empty gap above it. On the computer and the web. - **The Tasks pill drops tasks the agent no longer has:** after a Claude session restarts, or when Claude answers with an empty TaskList or says a task doesn't exist, the old tasks leave the pill, and a TaskList that names tasks shows exactly those. Once Ghostex is updated on the computer running the session. - **OpenCode keeps showing that it's working for the whole turn:** the chat box shows Stop and the working word until OpenCode finishes, also when OpenCode's plugin stops reporting partway through a long turn (#529). - **One question to Chief of Staff, a GBot or Ask Ghostex no longer starts a swarm of Help chats:** Ghostex Help answers from its guide or says the guide doesn't cover it instead of asking itself again, asking again waits for the answer already on its way, and Chief of Staff, a GBot or Ghostex Help starts at most 6 sessions for one request.
### 📱 On the phone
- **New phone apps:** the new iPhone app (through the App Store after Apple's review) brings the full fix for the call microphone, which now starts again in place, and the new iPhone and Android apps connect to each Easy Connect computer with a key of their own, so two Easy Connect computers no longer slow each other down. Phones on the older apps keep working with this release, but get this release's phone changes and later updates only once you install the new app. - **New session at the top of the phone's Sessions list:** the pencil lists every project on every computer, recent ones first, and starts your remembered agent there in the view the phone's Default agent view picks; the phone also gets its own Hide projects without sessions switch, thanks to @sebastianarena. - **A computer's page on the phone puts what matters first:** Machines > a computer opens a page that says whether it is connected and how, shows its Approvals and the devices that can reach it, and keeps the rest behind one row each, instead of one long form with a Save button. With the new phone app. - **The phone's Machines screen is tidier:** a computer's state is coloured once ("Can't reach" instead of "Failed"), a tap opens the computer's page (swipe keeps Remove), and the ways to add a computer are one compact row each. With the new phone app. - **A busy coordinator chat on the phone stays light:** its live updates now carry only what changed, so watching it costs about 35 KB a minute of mobile data instead of about a megabyte. - **The iPhone's local network question makes sense:** it says Ghostex uses the local network to reach your computer directly, instead of a developer message about development servers. With the new iPhone app.
### 🎙️ Voice and Dictate
- **Dictate types exactly what the engine heard:** Ghostex no longer polishes dictated text with AI, removes filler words or keeps its own dictionary; set those up in Hex if you want them (OpenAI and xAI will mishear names more often). The speech models Ghostex's old built-in engine downloaded are deleted by themselves. - **The voice agent's status answer is short:** "What are my sessions doing?" gets the counts and the sessions waiting on you in a couple of sentences, with an offer to go into detail, instead of a half-minute list of every session. - **A voice call from your phone reaches your other computers:** the voice agent started from the phone reads and acts on the sessions of every computer that computer is connected to, as it does from the desktop. Needs Ghostex updated on the computer the call runs on.
### 🖼️ Terminal, Files and the window
- **Pictures in terminals:** programs that show pictures with the Kitty graphics protocol (agent CLIs that draw diagrams and charts, and TUIs that use Unicode placeholders) now draw them in Ghostex's terminals on the computer, as they do in Ghostty (#536, thanks to @adriancendon). The web terminal doesn't draw pictures yet, and a picture already on screen is gone after Ghostex reattaches to the session. - **No more stray "23;24;28;32;42c" in an agent's terminal:** with a session also open on a second computer, switching to its terminal no longer types that text into the agent's prompt or shrinks the terminal to the other computer's size. For sessions started after Ghostex is updated on the computer that runs them. - **Cmd+= and Cmd+- zoom in half the steps:** 5% around 100% instead of 10%, with the larger steps above and below halved too, and half a point for a terminal's own text zoom. 70%, 200% and Cmd+0 are unchanged. On the computer and the web. - **Grok Bot and Claude buttons moved to the header:** they sit, Grok Bot first, directly left of the "Talk to the voice agent" button (each only while its extension is on), and the Grok extension is now called Grok Bot in its tooltip and Settings. - **Cmd+D from a session in a sidebar folder keeps the split:** the new session joins that folder and opens beside it, and the other quick creates there do the same (#525), thanks to @roypadina. - **A project's buttons work on an entry that merges two copies:** Add Worktree, History, Create Agent and the launcher's agents act on the copy they name, and the Unified sidebar's project menu works for a project the Project sidebar hides (#534), thanks to @sebastianarena. - **The VS Code view and the web runtime stay installed across updates** (#530): when an update brings a new version of either, it updates by itself instead of asking again as if it were a first install, and a download identical to the one you have is kept without downloading it again. - **`.tsx` and `.jsx` files are coloured in Files** like `.ts` files: imports, strings, comments, keywords, JSX tags and attributes. - **Arrow keys no longer type a blank into a Ghostex page's text field** (a page's note box, the Code view or another web view) when a key was pressed before the web runtime finished loading.
### 🪟 Windows
- **Ghostex for Windows is signed** (#224): the installers and the app (Ghostex.exe, its runtime and helper, the editor, gxserver, wmx and the updater) carry a Certum code-signing certificate, and Windows names the publisher "Open Source Developer Mohamad Yahia Youssef", so SmartScreen and antivirus warnings about an unknown publisher should fade as the certificate gains reputation.

# Ghostex 11.2.2
## 11.2.2 - 2026-11-10
**Ghostex 11.2.2 is out.** Phones and Easy Connect computers stay connected through restarts and slow links, iPhone voice calls work even when the call microphone keeps stopping, Dictate never loses a recording, messages between agents fold into "Worked for", approvals work across your connected computers, and Android gets push notifications.
### 📱 On the phone
- **iPhones on 11.2.1 already have this release's phone fixes:** they arrived over the air, and the last ones come with this release's update. Per-computer Easy Connect keys and the full fix for the iPhone call microphone come with a later iPhone app; Android gets everything in this release's app. - **The phone is back right away after Ghostex restarts or updates on your computer:** over Easy Connect, the phone reconnects within a few seconds of Ghostex coming back, instead of showing "Reconnecting to …" for half a minute or more. - **The phone stays connected on a slow connection:** on weak cellular, or when Easy Connect or Tailscale goes the long way round, the phone no longer starts over while a chat, a long reply or a picture you're sending is still coming through, so nothing is lost, and a connection that really drops is still noticed and restored within seconds. - **A phone with two or more Easy Connect computers keeps them all connected:** once your phone app is updated, it connects to each computer with its own key, so connecting to one no longer stalls another for half a minute. Ghostex on your computers is ready for it now, and phones on the current app keep working as before. - **A phone on Tailscale or SSH asks each computer to pair once:** reopening the app or reconnecting waits on the same request instead of asking again, and one plain card says where to approve ("Approve this phone?" in Ghostex on that computer) and what waits meanwhile; it stays away for a computer that's asleep or that you hid. - **Android: push notifications reach the phone:** with this release's Android app, finished, waiting and error notifications arrive as push notifications. iPhones get them with a later iPhone app.
### 🎙️ Voice and Dictate
- **iPhone voice calls work even when the call microphone keeps stopping:** on iPhones where the call's microphone stops right after it starts (iOS 27 with the 11.2.1 app), the call switches to recorded turns: hold Talk, speak and let go to send, and the agent's replies show on screen and are read aloud. Needs Ghostex updated on the computer. - **A voice call survives Ghostex restarting on your computer:** a phone that reconnects to a call the restart cut off gets a new call with the same settings straight away (the screen says it is a new call), instead of "That conversation already ended", and Ghostex's log says how each call ended and when a microphone stopped sending sound. - **The phone's voice agent says what's missing and where:** when a computer has no voice key (or can't read it, or has the voice agent off), the phone names that computer and says to add the key in Settings > Voice Agent there; a call about all your sessions uses another computer that has a key, and "The microphone stopped." shows once instead of over and over. - **Dictate on the phone never loses a recording:** the phone keeps your audio until its words are in the chat box. If your computer can't be reached, it says "Waiting for your computer…" and sends it again on its own once the connection is back; leaving the chat keeps the recording, which waits above the chat box as "Recording not transcribed" with Transcribe, Share (iPhone) and ✕.
### 💬 Chat
- **Messages between agents and your answers fold into "Worked for":** with Tool call cards on (or Agent work set to Reduced), "Message to …", "Message from …" and "You answered …" cards no longer stand on their own; the turn's "Worked for" line counts them ("2 messages", "1 answer") and opening it shows them first, on the computer and the phone. - **The pills above the chat box no longer scroll or fade away:** when the row does not fit, pills drop their label from the right (icon and count stay, hover shows the name), and only then do the last ones go into one "+N" pill that lists them. On the computer, the web and the phone. - **Bigger text in the chat box's popovers and pills:** the Context window popover, the pills above the chat box and the lists they open use the same size as the model name (they were 9.5 to 12.5 px), with taller rows and wider menus so nothing clips. On the computer, the web and the phone. - **Questions with previews show each option's preview in full:** in the "Needs your answer" card a preview shows up to 10 lines, then scrolls with a visible scrollbar, and long lines scroll sideways instead of wrapping, so mockups stay lined up (#524). - **Press Enter while a pasted picture is still saving and the message goes at once,** with a loading tile where the picture will be; after a moment the Back to composer arrow lets you take it back, and a picture that can't be saved brings the message back with its error. - **Dialogs over the chat no longer black it out:** Save to Markdown and Rewind keep the conversation in view behind a light dim, and so does the Agents Hub's sync sheet; in Ghostex Web, every dialog laid over the page. - **Your messages to a coordinator show only what you typed,** with no "your playbook changed" line under them, and View playbook is on a coordinator's right-click menu, its chat's More actions menu, the phone's long-press menu and Settings > Chat > Coordinator playbook. - **New installs show no status line under the chat box** until you star items in Context details; everyone who already used Ghostex keeps the line they had, and Reset to recommended still pins the suggested setup. - **Claude Code's Fable 5.2 is in the model menu:** pick it and the pill shows Fable 5.2 instead of falling back to Fable 5.1, which still works too.
### 🌐 Remote computers
- **Remote machines over Easy Connect stay connected** (#526): a computer you control through Easy Connect no longer keeps dropping and reattaching its terminals, because all of its connections now share one link instead of competing with each other. - **Approve your connected computers' requests from the computer that controls them:** a request shows Approve only where approving it works. A computer with its own Ghostex app asks you once, there, to let this computer answer its requests; after that its cards work from here. Until then a notice says where to approve. - **Agents see the computers you connected, and say what's missing:** `ghostex computers` and every `--computer` command list a computer that still waits for your "Let the agents on … reach each other" approval and say which computer shows that card, instead of saying none is connected. - **Settings > Remote shows the Ghostex version a computer is really running,** the same as its About screen; when its background service still runs an older build, the tile says so ("background service 10.45.0") and what to do, and a failed version read is tried again within a minute. - **A remote computer's session drags onto the work area** to split a pane or show it in the middle, like a local one, pinned or not, in the Separate-by-machine tabs or the Unified sidebar. - **No more "Git unavailable on Windows" notice at every start:** Git stays quiet for a computer that isn't connected yet (or is asleep) and fills in once it connects; clicking Commit or the Git menu says plainly that it isn't connected, or is connecting.
### 🔒 Pairing and security
- **A phone pairing over Tailscale or SSH no longer opens Easy Connect to any device while it waits.** - **The "still use the old pairing" count in Settings > Remote counts only devices that really need pairing again:** it skips phones you removed, older or unused pairings, phones that now sign in over Tailscale or SSH and phones waiting for your Approve, and each old pairing that needs nothing has Forget. - **Settings > Remote's Relay picker fits its labels, and each option has an (i)** that explains Ghostex relay, Public relays only and Custom on hover. - **Settings > Remote's tab strips and pickers keep their labels off the edges at narrow widths,** shortening them with an ellipsis instead.
### 🧩 Settings, Files and accounts
- **Settings > Accounts: adding a Claude or Codex account you removed earlier no longer gets stuck** ("already saved, use its Reconnect action" or "Login did not complete"): Ghostex repairs the leftover saved entry and saves your sign-in without asking you to sign in again, and a sign-in that still fails says why, with Copy details. - **Settings > Extensions: click an installed or Community extension's tile to open its page** (details, settings, permissions, version, Update or Uninstall); Back returns to the same tab. - **Files moves lines with Option+Up and Option+Down** (Alt+Up / Alt+Down on Windows and Linux): the current line, or every line the selection touches, moves by one line, like VS Code, one undo step each.
### 🤖 GBots (beta)
- **Calls with a GBot:** call a GBot from its row or one of its chats through the Voice agent; it answers in its own voice (chosen in GBot Settings), says what it is doing while it works, asks permission prompts out loud (Touch ID approvals stay on the computer or phone), and the call's turns land in its chat.

# Ghostex 11.2.1
## 11.2.1 - 2026-11-09
**Ghostex 11.2.1 is out.** GBots come back as Ghostex's own bots (beta, off by default), chats get opt-in looks and one / key for skills, cloning runs in the background, Settings and Extensions get tidier, iPhone voice calls keep the microphone, and Windows and macOS get a round of fixes.
### 🤖 GBots (beta)
- **GBots are now Ghostex's own bots (beta, off by default):** turn on Main Hub, then GBots in Settings > Extensions > Experimental. The previous GBots and its separate download are gone; their bots and chats were not carried over, and their old files are in your Trash as "GBots (previous)". The Bots space shows Hermes bots again. - **GBots sit in Main Hub under Chief of Staff** on your computer and phone, each with its icon and colour and its chats folding under it; New Chat, GBot Settings and Remove GBot are a right-click (or long press) away, and GBot folders never show as projects. - **Chief of Staff hands work to your GBots:** it gives a job to the right GBot or asks one a question and gets the answer back in its chat; when no GBot fits it adds one and tells you in a "GBot added" card you can undo (Settings > Agents makes it ask first). `ghostex gbots ask`, `assignments`, `changes` and `undo` are new. - **GBots remember:** each GBot keeps short dated notes that load into every chat, longer topic notes and a daily log, and the oldest notes move to an archive when memory fills up. The Memory tab shows what loads and lets you edit or undo any change, and `ghostex gbots prefs set` sets preferences every GBot follows. - **GBot routines:** ask a GBot for something on a schedule and it sets a routine; a free check (new mail, a calendar event, a web page, a folder or a command) runs first so a quiet day costs nothing, each run is a chat of that GBot, and a "Routine set" card has Pause, Edit and Undo. - **GBot departments** group GBots with shared instructions and a lead who hands the others work; they show as small headings under GBots. - **GBots tell Chief of Staff when they're stuck:** a GBot chat that can't start, stops, goes quiet for 20 minutes or whose routine fails is reported to Chief of Staff, which restarts it where it stopped or tells you in two lines what only you can fix; it answers approvals only for GBots it added. - **Keep an eye on my day:** with Gmail or Google Calendar connected, Chief of Staff can set up Day Watcher, which briefs you every morning and warns you about a meeting about to start or important new mail, with a notification on your computer and phone. It only reads; Ghostex refuses anything it tries to send or change. - **Team files and presets:** export your GBots (or a department, or one GBot as a preset) as a JSON file with secrets removed, and import one with a preview first; routines arrive paused and Undo removes the whole import. New GBot can start from built-in or kept presets. - **GBot API:** an app or script on your computer can message a GBot and get its reply, or start one of its routines, with a key from GBot Settings > Bot API. It's off until you turn it on with your approval; messages from apps run in their own folder, can't read your secret folders, don't see the GBot's memory unless you allow it, and only you answer what they wait on. - **A computer per GBot:** in GBot Settings > Computer, a GBot's chats can run on one of your connected computers or a Cloud Box, still reading its instructions and keeping its memory here, optionally using that computer's screen and apps (Touch ID to give it more). - **GBots and Chief of Staff on Codex can run `ghostex` commands:** a new Codex GBot starts at Full access and Chief of Staff on Codex runs without asking; on macOS and Linux Codex still keeps them out of your secret folders. - **A GBot asked to start work in a folder adds it as a project** and starts the coordinator, thread or session there (`--path <folder>`), and nothing but a GBot's own chats can land in its hidden folder (#519). - **GBots hide completely while they are off,** including their chat cards, Quick Access folders and Automate routines, and GBot chats install the GBot playbook skill they are told to read, here and on a connected computer.
### 💬 Chat
- **Chat look settings (Settings > Chat > Advanced, all off by default):** messages that start at the left, your messages on a full-width band, the agent's work as one small line per message (Reduced) or behind a button on each reply (Quiet), the status line as the chat's last line, a chat box as wide as the transcript, and compact spacing; the phone follows the computer, thanks to @sebastianarena. - **Tool call lines (Settings > Extensions > Experimental, off by default):** each run of an agent's tool calls is one quiet line you open to see its calls, and running calls now shimmer in every look. On the phone the switch is in Settings > Chat. - **/ is the one key for skills and commands with every agent:** the list shows the agent's skills, then its custom and plugin commands, then its built-in commands, each under a heading, and each agent receives a picked skill in its own spelling. $ still opens the same skills, and a Codex message with two skills no longer shows the text between them as a formula. - **The skill picker lists a Claude Code plugin's skills and commands as Claude Code loads them** (#513): skills named in its plugin.json, commands in nested folders or named by the manifest, and a picked command reaches Claude as /plugin:name. The prompt editor draws command pills like the chat does. - **A Claude chat on a Claude Swap account reopens again** (#521): Ghostex finds the conversation in that account's own history, and a chat whose conversation really is gone says so and offers Start fresh, which starts a new conversation in the same session instead of leaving the input box stuck. - **Right-click an HTML file an agent linked to Open in Browser** in a new Browser tab of the session's project (#515). - **File and folder paths in Ghostex's own screens open in Files when clicked** (Settings pages and their descriptions, dialogs, chat folders): `~` expands to your home folder, a right-click offers Copy path and Reveal in Finder, and a folder outside the project opens in your file manager. - **A session's 5h and 7d limits read as reset once the reset time has passed** and take the newest reading from its login, so an idle coordinator no longer keeps its old percentages (#514). - **Text strength raises an agent's reply from its standard colour,** so the slider works with Show thinking in grey on. - **The working line above the chat box no longer repeats the running tool call's words** when the transcript already shows them; it shows the agent's status or its working word and time instead. - **The pills strip fades each pill out at a scrolled edge** instead of painting a dark band over them, so no half-pill stub is left, on the computer and the phone. - **A click on the coordinator board that jumps into a chat closes the board first,** so the chat is visible. - **Session Links: an × on the Suggested header removes every suggestion** in two clicks (the first arms it red); they go to Removed and can be restored, on the computer, the web and the phone.
### 🧩 Settings and Extensions
- **The Extensions page is in tabs:** Built-in, Views, Panels & menus, Installed, Community and Experimental, with one search over every tab, a short title on each tile with its description behind an (i), and the page reopens on the tab you had open. - **Each experimental feature has its own switch in Extensions > Experimental,** replacing Enable Experimental Features; Faster rendering moved there from About. - **Grok, a new built-in extension (off by default):** a Grok button beside Claude's opens grok.com inside Ghostex, with several Grok logins kept apart (each signed in on its own) and a start page you can set in Settings > Files & Links. - **Settings > Updates has the machine picker and Update all machines:** pick a machine at the top to see and update only its agents and tools, or update every connected machine at once with a line per machine saying how it went. Not installed pills install on a click and spin while they do. - **Settings never shows a long build id, hash or path whole:** it shows it short, and pointing at it shows it in full. - **Settings > Security shows only while Extensions > Experimental > Security logs is on (off by default):** the log is still written, its alerts and `ghostex security log` work as before, and a security alert's link still opens the page. - **Problems in Settings read plainly:** each one leads with a sentence, raw installer and command output moves under Details with Copy details, pages that can't reach Ghostex's service show one empty state with Try again, and Accounts says "Sign in needed" quietly. - **The Home folder card is the last on Settings > Agents,** and its folders row starts folded to a count ("25 folders") that opens the editable list. - **Merge copies of the same repository, a switch in Settings > Sidebar & Sessions:** turn it off to keep two copies of one repository on a computer as two projects; the phone follows it (#518). - **Settings > Autopilot says when the supervisor wakes,** and a supervisor that can't start or wake is logged and retried less and less often instead of every 10 seconds. - **When Connectors, Workspaces, Main Hub or Bot automations are off, the terminal hint now names a command that works.** - **Long text in the Updates popover is cut with an ellipsis inside the popup,** and hovering shows it in full.
### 🌐 Remote computers and projects
- **Cloning a project no longer holds the Add Project dialog open:** it runs in the background behind a progress button in the header, a project on another computer can be cloned onto any connected computer from its right-click menu (Clone on…), and the folder browser lists your home folder's folders again. - **The machine dialog (Settings > Remote) shows less at first:** each field's explanation is an (i) that appears next to its label when you point at the field, errors still show under the field, and Agent access moved into Advanced as its first row. - **A failing machine's tile shows two words and a red dot,** and its sheet leads with the problem, Reconnect, Reinstall and Copy details. - **Threads started with `--computer` get `GHOSTEX_COORDINATOR_ROLE=thread` and `GHOSTEX_COORDINATOR_SESSION` too** (#523), so launch wrappers on that computer can tell them from your own sessions. - **An approval a connected computer waits on shows there even when its app missed the moment it was asked,** and the asking app no longer shows one only that computer's owner can answer. - **A phone on Tailscale or SSH no longer brings up the pair-again notice** or its "can't connect" line in Settings > Remote. - **A command to a connected computer no longer gets lost right after that computer's Ghostex restarted** (#520), and Ghostex's log says when and why an Easy Connect connection ended.

- **iPhone voice calls keep the microphone** (#500): a call no longer loses it in a loop, "The microphone stopped." shows once, and Unmute or Talk brings it back. This arrives with the new iPhone app. - **A dropped connection says so on the phone** ("The connection to the computer dropped. Ghostex reconnects by itself…") instead of blaming Ghostex on the computer. - **The phone gets the chat look settings, Tool call lines, the / list's headings, GBots in Main Hub and the Suggested links ×** with this release.

### 🩹 Fixes and polish
- **Daily, weekly and cron automations run at their time in your timezone** (they ran on UTC time before) and handle daylight-saving changes. - **Long chats are faster:** loading older rows ends in half the time, a new row no longer rebuilds the whole transcript, and questions, the coordinator board and Resources are no longer rebuilt on every event. - **Ghostex uses less of your computer while idle:** the menu bar, the settings poll, the sidebar's flash and spinners, account usage and coordinator panels do less work.

# Ghostex 11.1.1

- **A connected computer asks once:** one approval card per pair of computers, never a PIN prompt every minute, and with Agent access off it never asks at all. - **The pair-again notice lists each device on its own row** with one status and a page per device, and tells you the good news: the security review is done and pairing again takes a moment. Every Easy Connect copy gives a code that can pair. - **Some things are yours alone, in Settings:** installing or turning on an extension and its permissions, secret providers, joining or setting up a team, and the settings that loosen security. # Ghostex 11.1.0
## 11.1.0 - 2026-11-08
**Ghostex 11.1.0 is out.** A security update that puts you in charge of everything sensitive, with safer pairing for phones and computers (including over SSH and Tailscale); Collab becomes an extension you install, with a new Share popover; Chief, one agent per computer you can ask about anything; calmer notifications; a calm card when a computer is offline, with messages held until it is back; Settings in six groups; and many fixes.
### 🔐 Security update - **You approve what matters:** turning on Easy Connect, letting a computer connect, Autopilot's approvals and limits, GBots, settings that loosen security, and an agent answering, stopping or typing into another session all wait for your approval with Touch ID, Windows Hello or your system password, or Face ID or the fingerprint on your phone. - **Agents and scripts can ask but never approve:** every session gets its own key when it starts, the `ghostex` CLI waits for your approval and then repeats the call, and settings only you may change can't be written through the API. - **Settings > Security keeps a security log** of every sensitive action, chained so an edited or removed entry is flagged; `ghostex security log` shows it in a terminal, and only the important entries reach the bell and the phone. - **Easy Connect serves only SSH and Ghostex itself**, an empty allow-list lets nobody in, and file links never open keys, Ghostex's own data or a project's hidden files like `.env`. - **Every downloadable component (Collab, GBots, the browser engine) carries Ghostex's signature**, checked before it is unpacked. - **After updating, a one-time notice lists the phones and computers that connect through Easy Connect and must pair again**, with the pairing QR right there, ticking each one off as it pairs; phones and computers on Tailscale, your network or SSH keep working.
### 📲 Pairing phones and computers - **Each phone pairs with its own device key** kept in the Secure Enclave or Android Keystore: it waits as Pending with three words, and you approve it on the computer, or on a phone already paired, only when the words match. Removing a phone cuts it off at once. - **Computers pair the same way:** paste a Show QR code into Add a machine, check the three words on both screens and approve. - **Phones that sign in over Tailscale, your network or SSH pair once too**, with the same three matching words; until then answers, Stop and typing from that phone wait for your approval. Run in terminal on the phone uses the phone's own key. - **Pairing again needs the new phone app** (Android in this release, iPhone on TestFlight).
### 🤝 Ghostex Collab - **Collab is now an extension:** the Ghostex you download doesn't contain it until you install it from Settings > Extensions (or right in the Share popover), with Touch ID; Settings > Collab and Share appear once it is installed, and Uninstall ends every share. - **The new Share popover is the live panel:** the link and code, who is watching and who is waiting, a Link lasts chip with 1 hour, 4 hours, 24 hours or Until I stop it, Review for a guest's waiting message, and Stop sharing that says who gets disconnected. The phone's Share sheet matches. - **Every share, Send mode and guest message you send on asks for your approval**, links need an eight-digit code, and the guest page is pinned to the exact version your Ghostex trusts. - **Guests can answer the agent's questions and open the chat's Ghostex pages and pictures**, and the guest page works on phones; their answers wait for you like their messages. - **Collab and GBots show in Settings > Updates and the Updates menu** with Update when a new version is out.
### 🌸 Chief - **Chief is one agent per computer you can ask about anything:** any session, agent, project or computer, and Ghostex itself. Its row with the Ghostex flower sits under the Spaces bar, on the computer and the phone. - **Chief reads every session and steers them for you** (messages, interrupts, answers prompts) without asking each time, hands project work to that project's coordinator, and leaves security, sharing and pairing to you. "Ask anything about Ghostex" in the Help menu opens its chat. - **Each computer has its own Chief**, and you can turn it off in Settings > Extensions > Chief.
### 🔔 Notifications - **Alerts come only when a session needs you:** a thread finishing stays quiet, a coordinator alerts only when its handover needs you, and every red dot alerts unless Autopilot heals it. - **The phone's bell is an inbox of sessions** under Needs you, Done and Failed, one row each, and Android's persistent notification follows it, thanks to @cagatay-io. - **The bell's dot counts only the rows its panel lists.**
### 🌐 Remote computers - **A calm "Windows PC is offline · last seen 2h ago" card** sits above the chat box when a computer is off or asleep, with Retry; a message you send then waits and goes out by itself when the computer is back, with Cancel. - **Machines that ask for a verification code (2FA) connect:** turn on Reuse an existing SSH connection in the machine's Advanced settings and sign in once in a terminal, thanks to @chen1plus. - **Updates covers every connected computer**, with Install for what one of them is missing. - **Autopilot and Not moving wait while the computer is offline** instead of nudging agents that can't hear them. - **Easy Connect recovers faster** after a stall or a network change on the phone.
### 🧭 Coordinators - **Playbook overrides replace editing the playbook**, and the coordinator picks which memory notes go into a thread's brief. - **A coordinator links its own threads on another computer**, and a thread's brief there waits out a folder-trust prompt (#497, #502). - **The Start menu lists Global Actions under a Global heading** (#501).
### 💬 Chat - **The agent's reply fades in, and a long one stops the chat at its top** so you read from the start. - **Opening a tool group or any fold at the bottom of the chat scrolls to show its end.** - **A board card mention is its own teal chip with the card's title**, dimmed once the card leaves the board. - **The model menu shows tabs only for agents you turned on**, its long tooltips stay inside the menu, and the "Not applied" reason shows in full, thanks to @cagatay-io.
### ⚙️ Settings and the window - **Settings lists its pages in six labelled groups**: Working, Appearance, Voice, Agents & Accounts, Connections, and Privacy & System; every page opens with a one-line intro. - **Frame the work area is on for new installs**, and macOS keeps the window buttons when the sidebar is collapsed (Settings > Interface > Advanced). - **The floating sidebar runs the full height, floats as a card inside the frame and keeps its traffic lights crisp**, thanks to @zxcvbinz. - **Dictation uses Hex**, Ghostex's own speech engine is gone, and Dictation and Voice Agent are separate pages with each key under its picker. - **The voice panel resizes from its edges** and follows new lines until you scroll up. - **Files groups filtered and searched files by folder**, and the Changes view can hide test files, on the computer and the phone.
### 🩹 Fixes and polish - **A Mac that runs gxserver without the Ghostex app can install skills**, thanks to @sebastianarena. - **Automatic account switches no longer hold back an account with room**, and a switch whose agent won't return to the shell reloads the session on the new account. - **The Gemini account shows Antigravity's Claude and GPT limits**, matching agy's /usage. - **Spaces sync keeps each folder of a repository in its own Space** and puts back Spaces that 11.0.0 folded together (#488). - **macOS: arrow keys no longer type stray characters into a Ghostex page's text fields.** - **A GBots conversation opens in the chat**, Cloud Boxes run the model and effort you picked, and Cancel stops a waiting setup at once. - **OpenCode names the provider when two providers share a model name** (#482), and push and event-stream fixes, thanks to @cagatay-io. - **The Install button for Ghostex Agent Guide works**, and the Secrets row's trash button and Uninstall all remove its skill. - **Long chats load older pages faster** and gxserver starts faster with many sessions.
